name: Monrovia (Liberia)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the arms of the Monrovia City Corporation: a shield with a key, palm and elephant beneath a chief with sun and star, above a scroll with the city's name.
history: The Monrovia City Corporation was created by law in 1973 and began work in 1976; its white flag bears the corporation's arms. No adoption date has been published.

features.role: arms of the Monrovia City Corporation
